target_scope.product: Desktop project browser on Linux and Windows importing untrusted ZIP content into a new project.
notes: Pinned source cache is from the commit named in source-index.json; the public CPython commit page identifies it as Python 3.13.9.

The Microsoft naming guidance is a live page retrieved 2026-10-12 UTC; no content hash was captured.
Product constraints are mapped separately to admitted local governing inputs P1-P5; they are requirements, not external scientific claims.
The exact supported text/media allowlist and numeric resource defaults are not specified by the brief and remain product release decisions.

claims: CPython extract/extractall sanitize names; zipfile.Path does not.

claims: CPython allocates central-directory data and ZipInfo objects before app member-count enforcement.

final_claim_map.governing_scope: Pinned CPython internals; the proposal's actual quotas and no-partial-publication behavior are not implemented or tested.

claims: Standard extraction is a viable alternative but does not meet the proposed product controls.

claims: UTF-8 flag takes precedence; fallback uses metadata_encoding or CP437; override is archive-wide.

unresolved_uncertainty: Mixed legacy encodings cannot be resolved by archive-wide override.

claims: CPython docs warn interrupted extraction can be incomplete and repeated extraction overwrites files.
